We missed our first final by just three points and many post mortems were held in the following days on how we had missed out. Commiserations to Ken, Stuart, Vince, Mike Bazire, John Wright, Phil Walker, Phil Lovell and the others who did so much - but if only!

Heavy points scorers for us during the year were the usual mob - Mike Small, Joe Minetti and Mike Bazire (but we could have done with Joe and Mike B in the Final relay!) Some good 3000's from John Wright, Matt Chaston and, in a surprise turnout, John Gladwin having a time trial with Dave Clarke.
10000m There were few runs of note over this distance but in the improving John Wright we had the Southern Counties bronze medallist and in Kiwi Daryl Fantham the Surrey County 3rd placer.
John Wright was second fastest Belgravian with 4 min 20 secs. Four teams finished at the Battersea park race and some unfamiliar names were recorded on an excellent day for the club.

In the mid 70's, John Stow ran up a record four consecutive wins with Oliver Foote taking three on the trot in 82/83; but very few Bels of the 80's have intervened at the sharp end of the list, only John Wright having made the top ten with an impressive solo 27.44 last March.
In the Fleet Half Marathon, John Wright was representing the Army and didn't score for us but he finished 10th in a fast time with some respectable running behind from our team which placed 8th.
